answer: For a poll on a pearl exhibit about a glacier voyage, the server checks signed allocations against a frozen roster. Each voter has 100 credits; allocating n votes to an option costs n² credits. It rejects invalid, repeated or over-budget allocations and sums accepted votes. Raising an allocation from 5 to 6 costs 11 more credits. Roster aliases can each obtain a budget, and unused credits have no cash value.
